sloka: ततः अस्य धनम् आजह्रुः सर्वम् एव उपजीविनः ।स राशिः सुमहाम्स्तत्र दर्शनीयो ह्यदृश्यत ॥२-३२-२७॥
transliteration: tataḥ asya dhanam ājahruḥ sarvam eva upajīvinaḥ ।sa rāśiḥ sumahāmstatra darśanīyo hyadṛśyata ॥2-32-27॥

translations.english: When all the dependents fetched the entire wealth of Rama, they were pleased to see the great heap of wealth.
